summary: Two independent R3 reviews agree that v29 closes the prior behavior horizon, event/terminal, two-generation, durability, effective hash-seed and M7 loader/CCC regressions, but leaves a registration/commit hash cycle, executes system startup hooks before verification, under-specifies the Gate state join and standardizer, lacks an executable aux-prefix behavior proof and closed supplement/review schemas, cannot infer security lifecycle availability from the frozen evidence, and omits staging cleanup/capacity and the COMMITTED marker mode.

limitations: Both reviewers were read-only and did not edit design, product, test, gate or ledger files.
Neither reviewer invoked quality_ledger or ran replay, training, real data, PIT certification, budget consumption or final-OOS access.
